# api — core-hub: the HTTP helpers of shingo-core/www/static/app.js
# a fresh page per call; "resolves"/"rejects" is the promise the page awaits.

shape: api is a function (method, url, body); verbs apiGet apiPost apiPut apiDelete: apiGet function, apiPost function, apiPut function, apiDelete function; no non-throwing door

## the request each verb sends (answered 200 {})
apiGet(url): /api/x "GET", headers {"Accept":"application/json"}, body none
apiPost(url, {a:1}): /api/x "POST", headers {"Accept":"application/json","Content-Type":"application/json"}, body "{\"a\":1}"
apiPost(url): /api/x "POST", headers {"Accept":"application/json","Content-Type":"application/json"}, body "{}"
apiPut(url, {a:1}): /api/x "PUT", headers {"Accept":"application/json","Content-Type":"application/json"}, body "{\"a\":1}"
apiDelete(url): /api/x "DELETE", headers {"Accept":"application/json"}, body none
api("PATCH", url, {a:1}): /api/x "PATCH", headers {"Accept":"application/json","Content-Type":"application/json"}, body "{\"a\":1}"
api("POST", url, null): /api/x "POST", headers {"Accept":"application/json"}, body none

## apiGet: every answer
200 JSON object: resolves {"id":7,"name":"PRESS-1"}, no toast
200 JSON {"ok":false,"error":"refused"}: resolves {"error":"refused","ok":false}, no toast
200 empty body: resolves null, no toast
204 no content: resolves null, no toast
200 not JSON ("ok"): resolves "ok\n", no toast
400 Edge writeError / Core jsonError {"error"}: rejects Error "process not found", no toast
400 Edge writeAdvisoryRefusal {"error","notice"}: rejects Error "changeover already running", no toast
409 Edge writeErrorWithExit {"error","exit"}: rejects Error "lane held", no toast
400 Core configRefusal {"error","errors","ok"}: rejects Error "Port must be a number.", no toast
409 Core kanbanHeld {"drain","error","needs_force"}: rejects Error "position holds bins", no toast
400 JSON {"error":""}: rejects Error "Refused (400)", no toast
400 JSON with no error key: rejects Error "Refused (400)", no toast
400 JSON whose error is an object: rejects Error "Refused (400)", no toast
400 JSON null: rejects Error "Refused (400)", no toast
400 plain text (http.Error): rejects Error "invalid bin type", no toast
400 empty body: rejects Error "Refused (400)", no toast
500 JSON {"error"}: rejects Error "database not answering", no toast
502 HTML from a proxy: rejects Error "Server error (502)", no toast
no answer (fetch rejects TypeError "Failed to fetch"): rejects Error "No answer from the server", no toast
